D021-D017_h001.question: I'm here because… well, my husband insisted. He says I’m not eating enough, and I’m losing too much weight, but I just don’t see it. In fact, every time I look in the mirror, all I can focus on is my stomach, or my thighs, and I just know they're still too big. It’s been going on for about eight months now. I've completely cut out carbs and most fats from my diet. I know it’s impacting my energy, I’m constantly cold, and getting through a day of reporting feels impossible sometimes, but the thought of gaining back even a pound… it terrifies me. I truly believe that if I ever let myself go, I’d become huge. My biggest fear is getting fat. Honestly, I look at myself and still see someone who needs to lose more weight.
D021-D017_h001.options:
A. Anorexia Nervosa
    B. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation)
    C. Bulimia Nervosa
    D. Body Dysmorphic Disorder

D021-D017_h002.question: "I'm here because… well, things just aren't right. I've been barely eating, maybe a bite or two at supper, sometimes just a few spoonfuls to get by. A. Anorexia Nervosa

    D. Body Dysmorphic Disorder
